units.source_text: 五年之后，太宰少弍任期已满，打算回京。

en.t: Five years later, the Dazai Shoni's term of office had ended, and he intended to return to the capital.

units.source_text: 然而路途遥远，旅费浩繁；而本人权势不大，宦囊羞涩。

en.t: But the road was long and the travel expenses were heavy; moreover, he had little influence and little money in his purse.

units.source_text: 因此迟疑不决，迁延度日。

en.t: So he hesitated, unable to decide, and let the days drag on.

units.source_text: 不料这期间少弍忽患重病，自知死期已近。

en.t: Unexpectedly, during this time the Shoni suddenly fell gravely ill and knew that his death was near.

units.source_text: 此时玉鬘年方十岁，容貌之美，见者无不吃惊。

en.t: At this time Tamakazura was only ten years old, and everyone who saw her was astonished by her beauty.

units.source_text: 少弍看了，对家人说：“看来连我也要舍弃她了！

en.t: The Shoni looked at her and said to his family, "It seems that even I must abandon her now!
How unfortunate her future will be!

units.source_text: 让她生长在这偏僻的乡间，实在委屈了她。

en.t: It is truly a hardship for her to grow up in this remote countryside.

units.source_text: 我常想设法将她送回京都，通知她的生身父母，然后听凭她的命运做主。

en.t: I have often thought of finding some way to send her back to Kyoto, inform her birth parents, and then leave her fate to unfold.

units.source_text: 京都地广人多，发迹有望，可以放心。

en.t: Kyoto is vast and full of people; there she would have hope of making her way, so one could feel at ease.

units.source_text: 岂料我此志未遂，就客死他乡……”

en.t: Who could have thought that before fulfilling this wish, I would die here as a stranger in a foreign place..."
He was anxious about Tamakazura's future.

units.source_text: 他有三个儿子，此时便向三人立下遗嘱：“我死之后，他事不须你等操心，但须速将此女送往京都。

en.t: He had three sons, and at this time he gave them his final instructions: "After I die, you need not worry about anything else, but you must quickly send this girl to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 至于我身后的法事，不必着急。”

en.t: As for the memorial rites after my death, there is no need to hurry."
